Posterior predictive check by group

Source: R/post_proc.R
post_pred_group.Rd

Compares observed counts per bin with posterior predictive (brms) or simulated (sdmTMB) counts, summed within levels of grp. Predicted totals are rescaled to the observed total within each group and draw, so the check is on the composition rather than on the total. Requires a fit from fit_model(..., add_preds = TRUE).

Usage

post_pred_group(mod, grp = NULL, xlab = "Length (cm)")

Arguments

mod

An object from fit_model

grp

Name(s) of the grouping variable(s) in the model data to check over (e.g. "Year"). NULL pools all strata.

xlab

x-axis label (the bin variable)

Value

A ggplot with predicted medians and intervals (black) and observed counts (blue), faceted by grp.

See also

fit_model()

Examples

dat <- data_prep(ex_comp, c("Year", "Season", "Vessel", "trip"), "length", "count")
fit <- fit_model("Year", "Season + Vessel", data = dat, backend = "TMB",
                 iter = 300, warmup = 100, thin = 2, add_preds = TRUE)
#> Model formula: tot_by_bin ~ 0 + bin + factor(Year):bin + (1 | bin:Season) + (1 | bin:Vessel)
post_pred_group(fit, grp = "Year", xlab = "Length (cm)")
